async function inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, options: ImportedOptions) {
  for (const item of items) {
    consume(

      await step(item),

      await step(item),
    );
  }
}
async function inOrderSteps(steps: Array<() => Promise<void>>, options: ImportedOptions) {
  for (const step of steps) { await step(/* await is only comment text */); }
}
